newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BMW S.Africa to lure 1 bln investment-paper.
newsitem.headline: BMW S.Africa to lure 1 bln investment-paper.

text.p: South African-based German motor firm, BMW South Africa, will attract an additional one billion rand in foreign investment spin-offs into the country from plans to maufacture a new model here for export to world markets, Business Day newspaper said on Tuesday.
